notes: Official postgres:18 image plus pgvector. Physical streaming replication (async) with a replication slot; PgBouncer in transaction mode with max_prepared_statements; HAProxy write (5000) and round-robin read (5001) endpoints.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSONB,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  parent_id INTEGER,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  depth INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSONB,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  payload JSONB,
  value_num DECIMAL(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)
fts_setup: CREATE INDEX ix_products_fts ON products USING GIN (to_tsvector('english', description))

pg_dump.notes: directory format, 4 parallel jobs, zstd; globals dumped separately with pg_dumpall

steps.name: prepare
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'rm -rf /backups/dump /backups/globals.sql'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'rm -rf /backups/dump /backups/globals.sql'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

steps.name: pg_dump -Fd
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_dump -U lab -d lab -Fd -j 4 --compress=zstd -f /backups/dump'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_dump -U lab -d lab -Fd -j 4 --compress=zstd -f /backups/dump'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

steps.name: pg_dumpall --globals-only
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_dumpall -U lab --globals-only -f /backups/globals.sql'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_dumpall -U lab --globals-only -f /backups/globals.sql'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

steps.name: create restore db
steps.cmd: DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS lab_restore; CREATE DATABASE lab_restore

steps.name: pg_restore -j
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_restore -U lab -d lab_restore -j 4 --no-owner /backups/dump'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_restore -U lab -d lab_restore -j 4 --no-owner /backups/dump'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

pg_dump.description: parallel directory-format dump restored into a second database

pg_basebackup.notes: plain-format full copy with streamed WAL (-Xs), verified with pg_verifybackup; restored by copying into a scratch container

steps.name: prepare
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'rm -rf /backups/full /backups/incr1 && mkdir -p /backups/wal'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'rm -rf /backups/full /backups/incr1 && mkdir -p /backups/wal'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

steps.name: pg_basebackup
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_basebackup -U lab -D /backups/full -Fp -Xs --checkpoint=fast --manifest-checksums=CRC32C'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_basebackup -U lab -D /backups/full -Fp -Xs --checkpoint=fast --manifest-checksums=CRC32C'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

steps.name: pg_verifybackup
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_verifybackup /backups/full'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_verifybackup /backups/full'; fi
steps.out:
backup successfully verified

Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

pg_basebackup.pg_verifybackup:
backup successfully verified

Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)
pg_basebackup.description: full physical copy restored in a scratch container

pitr.note: rows inserted after the full backup are present in the combined (full+incremental) restore

incremental.notes: block-level incremental (summarize_wal=on, PG17+), restored with pg_combinebackup full incr -o PGDATA

steps.name: pg_basebackup --incremental
steps.cmd: if command -v gosu >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gosu postgres sh -c 'pg_basebackup -U lab -D /backups/incr1 -Fp -Xs --checkpoint=fast --incremental=/backups/full/backup_manifest'; else exec su -s /bin/sh postgres -c 'pg_basebackup -U lab -D /backups/incr1 -Fp -Xs --checkpoint=fast --incremental=/backups/full/backup_manifest'; fi
steps.out: Defaulted container "primary" out of: primary, init-backup-init (init)

incremental.description: PG17+ block-level incremental on top of the full backup

pitr.notes: WAL archive (archive_command -> /backups/wal) replayed on top of the full backup up to the named restore point; the DELETE that followed is not replayed
